lede: Know where to ride, stay, eat and refill in Postojna.
intro: Postojna sits on the karst between Ljubljana and the coast, best known for its cave. For a rider it is a hub of marked routes: two local road routes, seven mountain-bike routes into the forests of Nanos and Javornik, and the Jakobova pot passing through. Villages such as Hruševje, Razdrto, Prestranek and Planina belong to Postojna too.

routes.title: Cycle routes through Postojna
routes.body: Ten signed routes pass through Postojna, most of them numbered local routes. On a road bike, route 2 (Jamska), 36 km, passes near the cave, and route 3 (Grajska), 54 km, runs out towards Planina. The Kolesarska Jakobova pot Slovenija Camino crosses the area on its 311 km through Slovenia, passing Predjama Castle. Seven marked mountain-bike routes cross the area, among them route 7 (Postojna), 68 km, and route 9 (Nanos), 57 km. Route 10 (Medvedova dežela) is the longest at 117 km.

stays.title: Where to stay with your bike
stays.body: There are 19 places to stay in Postojna, from hotels in town to farms in the villages. EkoTurizem Hudičevec is 15 metres from route 7, and Lipizzaner Lodge, which rents e-bikes, is 44 metres from the same route. In town, Hotel Kras and Sweet Dreams are both close to route 7, and Hotel Jama stands by the cave, 324 metres from route 2. With a tent or camper, Camp Mirjam in Razdrto is 73 metres from the Jakobova pot and open from mid-April to early October.

food.title: Where to stop and eat
food.body: Postojna has 11 places to eat, a few of them on the routes. Gostilna Hruševje is 19 metres from route 3 and cooks traditional Slovenian dishes, pizza and burgers. Riding route 9? Avio Pub in Rakitnik is 99 metres from it and is closed on Mondays. In town, Pizzerija Čuk has Neapolitan pizza, and Bistro Štorja cooks with seasonal local produce.

practical.title: Water, repair and charging
practical.body: You can refill a bottle at 23 public water points, and 13 of them are within 150 metres of a signed route. There are three public repair stands and one bike shop, Ceho Bike, in town. Riding an e-bike? Postojna has 9 public chargers.

sights.title: What to see on the way
sights.body: Postojna has 50 sights, and the best known are underground. Postojna Cave is 323 metres from route 2, and Otok Cave and Betalov spodmol, a cave where Stone Age tools were found, are along the same route. Predjama Castle, built into the mouth of a cave, is 140 metres from the Jakobova pot. Planina Cave is 265 metres from route 3, and Pivka Jama is 39 metres from route 9.
